releases.title: Texture, character and theme feedback
changes: Added texture guides and three matching drawings for every theme, shared with the job board.
Separated optional theme likes and dislikes from theme selections in the analytics dashboard.
Made theme feedback easier to dismiss and kept it out of job detail windows.

releases.title: Quieter notices and a familiar homepage
changes: Replaced the automatic privacy form with a short notice and optional detailed choices.
Restored graduation-photo enlargement within the homepage, without a popup.
Updated the mobile bookmark prompt and made its instructions easier to read.

releases.title: A clearer way back
changes: Shortened the welcome detail action to go back.

releases.title: Your interests, your choices
changes: Optional personalized ordering follows the career fields and roles you explore, with higher disclosed pay among comparable jobs.
Separate analytics and recommendation controls, a history reset, and clearer privacy explanations.
A private owner dashboard summarizes measured activity and answers supported questions.

releases.title: Every theme, with a clearer welcome
changes: Explore all eight themes in the style guide, now linked from Version History.
A roomier Version 2 welcome puts the tracker first and gives each feature one clear way back.
Optional Google sign-in in the application feedback note keeps your unanswered question through sign-in.

releases.title: Back to the notebook
changes: Shared warm yellow, handwritten welcome and suggestion notes, a visual style guide, and a shorter mobile bookmark reminder.
Featured job cards follow salary bands, with clearer action text.

releases.title: Meet Version 2
changes: A welcome on your first Jobs visit introduces advice, themes, Google sync and Tracker, plus a Portfolio Graded preview.
A tighter homepage, Apply to Jobs beside Nic’s signature, and easier access to Bookmark and Suggest Jobs.
Version history is available from the founder note, board footer and welcome.
Six additional verified job URL variants now group into their original postings.

releases.title: The new board
changes: Saved jobs and applications sync across devices with Google sign-in.
Clearer navigation and mobile controls.
One card per recognized job posting, with existing saved links preserved.
Search and filter across all 14 job categories.
A roomier desktop homepage, clearer bookmark shortcut and clickable graduation photo.
Restored founder notes and clearer Sign In and Signed In labels.
Suggest Jobs sends links to a private review inbox before any publishing decision.
Version history now lives beside the homepage footer links.
